text: {"lessons":["The account’s later decline and partial recovery show that a short run of results cannot tell me what comes next; I should avoid reacting to recent moves.","After selling Stock C and buying the other stocks, the portfolio still fell before recovering; that sequence does not prove the trades caused either outcome, so I should assess decisions by their rationale and portfolio-wide risk.","I made no trades for most periods, which helped me avoid unnecessary activity; I should trade only when a clear plan-based reason outweighs the urge to respond to daily fluctuations."]}
